evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports that the 3.8B-parameter model reaches a level of multilingual language understanding and reasoning comparable to much larger models.

identity.name: phi-4-mini-instruct
identity.summary: A lightweight open language model focused on high-quality, reasoning-dense data.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: text-generation model trained on synthetic data and filtered websites, with no reported factuality/grounding evaluation, plausibly produces factually inaccurate content

possible_risks.description: Unrepresentative data occurs when the training or fine-tuning data is not sufficiently representative of the underlying population or does not measure the phenomenon of interest. Synthetic data might not fully capture the complexity and nuances of real-world data. Causes include possible limitations in the seed data quality, biases in generation methods, or inadequate domain knowledge. Thus, AI models might struggle to generalize effectively to real-world scenarios.
possible_risks.justification: training data is synthetic and filtered websites with emphasis on reasoning-dense content, so it may not capture real-world complexity and generalization

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: card states training data includes synthetic data and filtered publicly available websites but does not provide traceability or generation details for the synthetic data

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: card gives only a high-level description of training data and does not document dataset details or synthetic data generation process

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: card describes primary task as text generation but does not define intended use or misuse boundaries, leaving downstream risk scope undefined

specifications.model_size: 7.1 GiB of safetensors weights (7,672,066,216 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model was post-trained through supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization to improve instruction adherence and safety.
training_context.training_data: Phi-4-mini-instruct was trained on synthetic data and filtered publicly available websites, with an emphasis on high-quality, reasoning-dense content.
